phase: SFC regression stages 1-3 on the delayed-first-enumeration prototype rcv1-pp-d1000 with the first controller

image.note: Prototype app at 0x10000 over the original 07e005a bootloader and partition table; not the main-branch build.

controller_and_connection.controller: first physical SFC, firmware not rewritten (usages match public v1.0.0, SELECT=Tab)
controller_and_connection.cable: user-reported direct USB-C to USB-C, orientation unchanged but not established

method: R1-R3 in one capture opened with the usual resetting UART open (the board booted with the SFC attached); R4 in a second resetting capture started with the SFC unplugged. Button operations were requested in chat; times are ESP log timestamps of the mask lines (the Host logs only changes).

r1_attached_boot_and_stage_1_2.boot: ROM POWERON, initial attach at uptime 1154-1155 ms, DEVICE 1209:d004 at 1771 ms, keyboard start ESP_OK at 1871 ms, released report at 1881 ms; recovery note normal

twelve_buttons.order: B, Y, SELECT, START, Up, Down, Left, Right, A, X, L, R

simultaneous_and_partial_release.meaning: B only released; Right+Y held 4.91 s

r2_disconnect_while_held.held_before_unplug: Right (0x080), with Up (0x010) appearing briefly several times while the controller was handled; mask 0x090 at the moment of unplug
on_unplug: E USB HOST: EP command error: ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE (one line)
r2_disconnect_while_held.replug: DEVICE address=2 at 232711 ms, keyboard start ESP_OK at 232811 ms, recovery note normal (no action)
r2_disconnect_while_held.after_replug_inputs: Right 0x080 and B 0x001 (briefly overlapping 0x081), released to 0x000
r2_disconnect_while_held.result: passed; all-release on unplug and recovery after replug
r2_disconnect_while_held.note: The single E line at unplug did not affect disconnect handling or the replug; its cause was not investigated in this record.

r3_physical_reset.each_boot: ROM POWERON, App version rcv1-pp-d1000, initial attach at uptime 1155 ms, DEVICE 1209:d004 at 1771 ms, keyboard start ESP_OK at 1871 ms
r3_physical_reset.note: The SFC stays powered through the FNK0099 RESET (EN reset), the condition that failed 0/8 on the original Host.

r4_boot_without_sfc_then_host_first.boot_without_sfc: Initial attach on an empty root port at uptime 1155 ms; no recovery action, no errors, free_heap constant (364432) for 34 s
r4_boot_without_sfc_then_host_first.enumeration: DEVICE 1209:d004 at 35201 ms, keyboard start ESP_OK at 35301 ms, recovery note normal

interpretation: With the first root-port power-on delayed to about 1.15 s, the first controller passed the stage 1-3 regression items on HID 1.1.0: attached-boot recognition, twelve single-button transitions, 30 s+ holds, simultaneous press with partial release, all-release on disconnect while held with recovery after replug, three physical RESETs with the SFC powered, and host-first insertion after a boot without the SFC. The recovery state machine never acted. Only one controller and the C-to-C cable were used, each item was run once (RESET three times), and the minimum sufficient delay is not known.
not_tested: second controller and the older cable assembly
a minimal main-branch change without the recovery state machine

final_state.fnk0099: rcv1-pp-d1000 prototype app (not the main-branch build)

privacy: Fixed button operations and selected diagnostic fields only. Raw UART, UART port, MAC, absolute local paths and device serials remain outside Git.
